body_html:
Overall a strong interactive read aloud. You are focusing on developing the skill of partner talk rather than focusing on a specific book yet you have students use multiple comprehension strategies. #edu407

Just make sure to focus your feedback on the quality of partner discussions such as noticing when they challenge each other or use textual evidence in dialogue.
